convert_hubert_s3prl_checkpoint: convert an s3prl Hubert checkpoint to a HuggingFace PyTorch model format
run_hubert_checkpoint_conversion_cli: run the CLI tool to convert s3prl Hubert checkpoint to HuggingFace format using argparse arguments
build_hubert_sequence_classification_mod: build a HubertForSequenceClassification model from a pretrained base model with custom config
load_hubert_config_from_pretrained: load a HubertConfig from a pretrained configuration path for downstream classification
save_hubert_model_and_feature_extractor: save a converted Hubert model and Wav2Vec2FeatureExtractor to a specified output directory
